title: WorkCenter/MachineCenter: add Capacity Shown In to Calendar and Load pages
summary: Work Center and Machine Center Calendar and Load pages now include a Capacity Shown In field to display capacity figures in different units of measure (seconds, minutes, hours, or days), matching the functionality already available on Work Center Group pages.
key_points: Added Capacity Shown In field to the Work Center and Machine Center Calendar and Load pages
Field initializes from Manufacturing Setup Show Capacity In and lets users switch capacity units
Calendar matrix Load() gains a capacity unit parameter and converts Capacity (Effective) with TimeFactor
Load lines SetLines() gains a unit parameter; Capacity, Allocated Qty. and Availability After Orders are converted, Load % unchanged
Implementation mirrors the existing Work Center Group pages
quote: Work Center and Machine Center Calendar and Load pages were missing the Capacity Shown In field that the Work Center Group pages already have.
